# Roofing Insurance Agency

> Roofing Insurance Agency (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides commercial insurance for this trade in all 50 states. Coverage lines: General Liability Insurance for roofing contractors, Workers' Compensation for roofing contractors, Commercial Auto Insurance for roofing contractors, Tools & Equipment Coverage for roofing contractors, Commercial Umbrella Insurance for roofing contractors, Commercial Property Insurance for roofing contractors, Contractors Pollution Liability for roofing contractors, Surety Bonds & Licensing for roofing contractors. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
